In honor of Lulu Gribbin, a courageous Alabamian, Lulu’s Law is now federal law.

When a shark attack happens, wireless emergency alerts can help warn nearby beachgoers about unsafe water conditions, giving families more time, more awareness, and more protection.
posts.summary: Celebrates enactment of shark attack warning legislation
posts.quote:
In honor of Lulu Gribbin, a courageous Alabamian, Lulu’s Law is now federal law.

When a shark attack happens, wireless emergency alerts can help warn nearby beachgoers about unsafe water conditions, giving families more time, more awareness, and more protection.

posts.text:
I couldn’t be prouder to have led this bipartisan effort in honor of Lulu Gribbin, and I’m deeply grateful to my colleagues who joined me in supporting this commonsense legislation. 

As countless Americans enjoy our nation’s beaches, the enactment of this law will help keep families safer, a testament to Lulu’s extraordinary grit and tenacity.
